title: makato-plan General Config
description: Central configuration for the makato-plan plugin. Controls skill execution behavior, review output, agent settings, and behavioral modes (TeamSize, Status). LLM-agnostic — no model selection here. Loaded by skills at runtime from config/general.yml.

TeamSize.description:
Solo = single-person project. Team = multi-person team.

When Solo:
  - Skills do NOT ask ownership/assignment questions (who will do X, who owns Y, who is the lead PO, which team works on this).
  - decompose: teams[] field defaults to ["solo"], not asked.
  - create-prd: Stakeholder identification questions are skipped.
  - HTML reviews are NOT generated (equivalent to MAKATO_PLAN_NO_HTML=1).
  - Review output is Markdown only. MD review files use numbered sections (§1, §1.1, §1.2 ...) so the reviewer can reference specific parts by number when requesting changes.

When Team:
  - All ownership, assignment, and team questions are active.
  - HTML interactive reviews with feedback textareas are generated and opened in browser.
  - doc-writer agent operates in html-review mode.

Status.description:
Project lifecycle status.

Development (or Dev):
  - Skills focus on technical solution planning only.
  - create-architecture: Deployment section (strategy, environments, rollback, infra) and Migration section are SKIPPED.
  - create-prd: Phased Rollout section and Delivery Recommendations section are SKIPPED.
  - decompose: Feature toggle capture (Round 2.5) is SKIPPED. Deployment-related story labels are not emitted.
  - to-issues: plan-template.md deployment fields are left empty.
  - Rationale: during development phase you are iterating on the technical design; deployment planning is premature.

Production (or Prod):
  - Full pipeline — all deployment, rollout, migration, and feature toggle sections are active.
  - create-architecture emits full Deployment + Migration sections.
  - create-prd emits Phased Rollout + Delivery Recommendations.
  - decompose captures feature toggles and deployment dependencies.

agents.description: Per-agent runtime settings. Keys are agent IDs.

maxFindings.description: Max findings per story in Three Amigos review.

maxGherkinScenarios.description: Max draft Gherkin scenarios per story.

fileSizeWarningKB.description: File size threshold (KB) that triggers a warning during prototype generation.

defaultSessionDepth.description: Default brainstorming session depth. quick=15min/1 technique, standard=30min/2-3 techniques, deep=60min+/multiple techniques.

toIssues.description: Defaults for the to-issues skill. CLI flags override these at runtime.

mode.description: interactive = user confirms labels before creation. autonomous = silent, no prompts.

dryRun.description: When true, equivalent to DRY_RUN=1. No gh issue create calls; synthetic numbers assigned.

ghHost.description: GitHub host. Only github.com is supported in to-issues v3; enterprise hosts are blocked.

readyQueueMode.description: manual = issues stay in Todo until explicitly moved. autonomous = no-label issues auto-promote to Ready.

skipVerify.description: When true, equivalent to ITP_SKIP_VERIFY=1. Skips board ID probe on first call.

webhookStrictLink.description: When true, equivalent to ITP_WEBHOOK_STRICT_LINK=1. WEBHOOK_NOT_ACTIONABLE exits with code 1 instead of 0.

unknownRepoBehavior.description: warn = log warning on unknown repos during reconcile. error = HALT with UNKNOWN_REPO.

autoReinit.description: When true, automatically re-initializes config when stale config is detected.

storyConstraints.description: Story point validation rules enforced by decompose and to-issues.

maxStoryPoints.description: Hard cap on story points. Stories exceeding this with no safe split trigger a BLOCK error.

validPointValues.description: Valid Fibonacci story point values. Off-scale values trigger immediate BLOCK.

defaultOutputMode.description: Default Excalidraw output mode. obsidian=.md, standard=.excalidraw, animated=.excalidraw with animations.
